github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, perf, build, ci, chore, style, security, revert.
Preferred scopes: core, engine, word, libreoffice, gotenberg, cli, api, validation, fonts, config, container, docs, tests, ci, release, deps.
Use concise English, lowercase imperative wording, no trailing period, maximum 72 characters.
Use ! and a BREAKING CHANGE footer when the public API is incompatible.
